page_title: BUR 2-2 FUL | Burnley v Fulham 03/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Willian (Fulham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
90+2' David Datro Fofana (Burnley) gets a yellow card.
90+1' 2 - 2 David Datro Fofana (Burnley) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Substitution. Han-Noah Massengo (Burnley) in, Lorenz Assignon out.
87' Here is a change. Vitinho is going off and Vincent Kompany gives the last tactical orders to Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley).
86' Maxime Esteve (Burnley) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Darren Bond has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
85' Substitution. Kenny Tete (Fulham) on for Andreas Pereira.
84' Sander Berge (Burnley) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Darren Bond had an easy-decision to make.
80' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
79' The attendance for today's match is 20203.

79' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Fulham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' A player from Burnley takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
76' The statistic for corner kicks – 2:11.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bobby De Cordova-Reid departs the field of play to be replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
74' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Rodrigo Muniz will be replaced by Armando Broja (Fulham).
71' 1 - 2 Goal! Lorenz Assignon produces a brilliant lofted pass and David Datro Fofana (Burnley) gets on the end of it to finish with a header into an empty net. The score is 1:2.
71' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

70' Willian (Fulham) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the right post is, however, superbly saved by James Trafford! The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.
70' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
67' Willian finds Timothy Castagne (Fulham) inside the box with a nice lofted pass, but he spanks the shot well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
66' The Burnley players are exchanging some short passes.
64' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
63' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Zeki Amdouni as he is replaced by David Datro Fofana (Burnley).
63' Vincent Kompany has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Johann Berg Gudmundsson (Burnley) replacing Aaron Ramsey.
60' James Trafford pulls off a great save to deny Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal.
57' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

57' Tosin Adarabioyo (Fulham) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fulham are going to take it.
57' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

56' Great save! Willian (Fulham) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by James Trafford. Fulham earn a corner.
56' Willian (Fulham) works the corner short.
56' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
53' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Andreas Pereira (Fulham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
53' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
52' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
50' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) sends the free kick into the box, but James Trafford leaps to intercept it.
49' Dangerous play by Vitinho (Burnley). Darren Bond blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Vitinho (Burnley) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Vincent Kompany probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Hjalmar Ekdal. He is replaced by Maxime Esteve (Burnley).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' It must be a yellow card. It is. Harrison Reed (Fulham) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
42' Darren Bond couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lyle Foster (Burnley) and blew his whistle.
41' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
39' The game is interrupted. Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.

38' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) lacks options so fires a shot at goal from the edge of box, but it's a wasted effort and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
35' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

34' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from James Trafford, who tips the ball around the post. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
29' Willian (Fulham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
28' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
26' Lorenz Assignon (Burnley) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren Bond saw the whole situation.
24' Lyle Foster (Burnley) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' 0 - 2 GOAL! Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over James Trafford, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:2.
20' Fulham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
17' 0 - 1 The corner from Andreas Pereira goes into a dangerous area and finds Joao Palhinha (Fulham), who outjumps the defence and glances a header into the back of the net. 0:1.
17' The referee points to the corner flag and Fulham will take a corner.
16' Fulham have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

16' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Fulham have a corner.
15' Josh Brownhill (Burnley) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
15' Wilson Odobert (Burnley) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. Burnley win a corner kick.
12' Sander Berge (Burnley) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno was alert and made a comfortable save.
11' Harrison Reed (Fulham) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
9' The Fulham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
7' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) commits a rough challenge and Darren Bond blows his whistle for an infringement.
6' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' Vitinho (Burnley) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Good work from Burnley as they win a corner.
4' Great teamplay by Fulham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out at last! Burnley will take the kick-off.
Darren Bond got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
